method: Apply the proposed core-identity patch to a clean pinned Stax worktree. A rootless fake daemon emits invented PET/PMC records with alternating kdebug cpuid values 0 and 4, while a real M1 Metal app reports target spans. Save a v3 Stax archive, then import and query it with the M1 topdown branch. No root helper or hardware PMU capture is used.

limitations: The CPU IDs, PMCs, and CPU stack records are synthetic. This proves software preservation of the raw ID, not physical M1 core residency, P/E topology classification, PMU scope, or complete sample delivery. The patch is a proposed upstream change, not part of the pinned installed Stax binaries.
